answer: Streak-weighted voice: an agent's grading weight grows only with an unbroken streak of epochs in which it answered and was attested, and one missed epoch resets it to zero, like a lantern that must be fed every night or go dark. A sparrow farm can't hatch trusted voices overnight; each fake must pay compute and earn real attestations every epoch for months, and dropping any to save money wipes its weight. Patience, not opal-bright wealth, is the price.
